tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Query an NTP server for current UTC time and this clock's offset. Appends the sample to the drift log and returns the trend inline: current offset, drift rate (ms/day), and whether the clock is stable, drifting, or accelerating.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a 'local' field, e.g. America/New_York. Optional -- the HTTP transport also takes ?tz= in the URL.

tools.name: generate_uuid
tools.description: Generate one or more random UUIDv4 identifiers -- for records, sessions, and IDs created in agent pipelines.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Unified diff between two texts, with added/removed line counts. For reviewing edits, comparing outputs, or validating transformations.

context.description: Lines of context around each change

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate a math expression safely: + - * / // % **, parentheses, functions (abs round min max sqrt floor ceil exp log log2 log10 pow sin cos tan), constants pi e tau inf. Parsed to an AST and only whitelisted nodes are computed -- no eval(), no names, no arbitrary code.

tools.name: attest
tools.description: Wrap any payload in a tamper-evident record: a UUID, a timestamp (NTP-verified when reachable, local clock otherwise -- the record says which), and a sha256 over the canonical record. One call, the record is complete and tamper-evident.

server.description: NTP server for the verified timestamp

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Check a record produced by attest: recompute the sha256 over the record and compare. Pass/fail -- did this payload produce this hash at this timestamp. Any modified field breaks it.
